hero.subtitle: Historic 18th-century Gustavian manor house, in the heart of the village of Breechen. Available exclusively as a whole — for up to 21 guests.

intro.titleA: A house that has welcomed guests for
intro.p1: Andreashof was built in 1782 as the manor of a Pomeranian landed family — right in the small village of Breechen, behind its hedge and gates. The symmetrical façade, the high half-timbered gable and the restrained proportions still speak of the Gustavian taste of that era, a Scandinavian elegance that carries to this day.
intro.p2: Behind the tall windows: light-filled rooms, white-washed floorboards, linen and stone. Room for 21 guests, but never cut off — neighbours in the village, a bathing lake and fields at the door, Greifswald and the Baltic Sea not far.

items.q: We spent a weekend in the house with the whole family. It was simply fantastic — even more beautiful than in the photos. The hostess is very friendly and helpful.
A wonderful birthday weekend here with my best friends — we felt more than at home. The interior is carefully chosen and beautifully suits the house.
Our company offsite at Andrea's was absolutely incredible. The space was comfortable, clean and perfectly suited for our team. Andrea is a fantastic host — attentive, welcoming, helpful.

items.q: Can you rent part of the house, or only the whole?
items.a: Andreashof is rented exclusively as a whole, to preserve the atmosphere for your group.
Yes. We regularly host weddings, family gatherings and private celebrations. We're glad to recommend caterers and local services.
Free parking for up to twelve vehicles in the inner courtyard.
Well-mannered dogs are welcome on request. Please let us know when you inquire.
Free cancellation up to 60 days before arrival. Details in our terms.
